nom: Magic Molecule Hypochlorous Acid Hydrogel Spray

avis.texte: the only thing i dont like about this product is the smell, but other than that this spray works!!! my skin was irritated with rashes and itchiness from skincare products i have used, so i spray this magic molecule on my skin and for 1-2 days my skin started feeling a lot better. So thankful for this spray. may u always exist cus I need u everyday. it also helped my armpit to not stink. love it.

I purchased this product myself and this is an honest review. I am in my late 30s and have sensitive, combo skin. Pretty much anything tends to cause "sensitive" breakouts. Not really classic acne per se but reactive marks. Anytime I try something that targets problem skin, it creates problems for me. Targeted acne spot treatment or patches occasionally help but it's temporary and doesn't treat the overall issue. I was in Ulta last week and was debating between this and a targeted spot treatment as I had a breakout and was just so tired of spending money on stuff that doesn't work. I have been using this twice a day (morning and evening) and am so happy I decided to go with this. I spray it right after cleansing on my face and chest (where I also get reactive breakouts) and a spray on my upper back as well. This formula doesn't drip so I dont rub it in. It dries completely in a few minutes and I apply my serum and face cream. This has significantly improved my skin..to wear I don't have to wear makeup…in a few days. I noticed a difference in one day. And it's crazy this brand seems to be under the radar a bit…it was kind of hidden on a lower shelf in the store. It's really affordable, especially compared to a well known brand (SOS). I had to go through a ton of research just to discover this. And apparently you can use it on eczema, sunburns, bug bites, etc. I highly recommend this product for basically anyone…but especially if you are an adult that's frustrated with acne and

I love this stuff so much. I have really dry/sensitive skin and washing my face twice a day can be too stripping. I love this for the mornings and my normal routine at night. It is perfect for a midday refresh too and my skin has been so clear since

I really liked this, I only docked a star because of packaging. It didn't break but I kept having to pull up the top part between every spray so I could push down and actually have product come out. The consistency is a little too thick for the nozzle.
I always have a bottle of Magic Molecule on my bathroom counter, we use it for everything from acne to cuts and bug bites!

I struggle with red and itchy skin after showering from time to time, and since adding this to my routine, my skin has completely calmed. I mean COMPLETELY. I spray only on problem areas (face and chest), after toner and before serum/moisturizing. An absolute miracle product, I will never stop buying.

I love how refreshing & clean my skin feels after using this, like a toner. The only thing I noticed about this vs the original spray is it pilled a couple times depending on the moisturizer I used. I'll just use it on its own or at different times.
Has helped my skin and my skin tone drastically and before that I've tried everything. This is the only thing that's worked, and I will continue to buy it.!

avis.titre: I would not purchase ths product again.
avis.texte: I have been using the product for several days; however, I have not noticed any improvement in my skin.

Magic Molexule is a staple in our home and I have a bottle in every room! My kids ask for it for everything like scrapes, bug bites or any skin irritation. I use it on my face before bed. It's THE BEST! I endorse it to every person I talk to. I believe in it and love this brand!

Honestly, shocked. I thought I would never find a better product than their OG spray but this puppy might actually be my new favorite. I'm a big-time runner (average about half a mile/day) and get the worst rashes and chafing. The gel instantly cooled and calmed my skin. I don't know if I'm supposed to but I sprayed it all over my body. . . back, face, chest, thighs. Can't recommend it enough!!
Love this spray! My skin gets super dry, and this has honestly helped so much. It also feels amazing after a sunburn, instantly cooling and really helps calm the redness.
I am a HUGE fan of the regular spray and now this hydrogel!!! I use them both all of the time. I love how targeted the gel is and how it feels! Definitely recommend!!
I just got my entire back tattooed and used this to calm down my skin as it was burning and red! This calmed it down immediately and brought me so much relief.

Soooo soft and calming. I am a big fan of the liquid spray, but sometimes it gets drippy (I spry my face a LOT ) esp when I'm getting ready for bed. So was excited to try. PERFECT--it's not sticky or runny. I am almost out of spray so def ordering both next time!
After a few days of using Magic Molecule Hydrogel, my skin looks brighter and more even. People have actually commented that I look more 'glowy. ' I'm a huge fan!
I love the cooling effect when I apply it—it's so soothing. My skin feels soft, calm, and moisturized. Even my makeup goes on smoother afterward.

I am the biggest fan of magic molecule hydrogel I was itching and itching and itching. I was about to put my Cortizone cream on cause I couldn't take it anymore and I said you know what let me try it. I can't even begin to tell you the relief. It doesn't itch it doesn't burn it saved me from putting that crappy medicine on my hands!
I never write reviews, but I saw an almost immediate improvement with my skin condition. This stuff works. . .

Love this spray! My skin gets super dry, and this has honestly helped so much. It also feels amazing after a sunburn! instantly cooling and really helps calm the redness. Thank you Magic Molecule, you created yet another life saver!

avis.titre: Didn't think it could get better!
avis.texte: The original daily skin spray was already amazing, but the Hydrogel really takes it up a notch. It's drip-free, easy to use, and since adding it to my routine, my skin has been looking and feeling great! This Hydrogel is a new essential!

avis.titre: The product I've been dreaming of
avis.texte: I was already obsessed with Magic Molecule's Daily Skin Spray and had often wondered if they'd come out with a gel formulation. I love the way it clings to my skin after a hard workout when my skin is crying out for help– it's super soothing.

I didn't think it was possible to love Magic Molecule more, but Hydrogel proved me wrong!!! It's the perfect second spray to have on hand for spots I want to spray a million times but don't want any dripping, like all the bug bites I always get on my ankles. I also spray it every night right before bed and when I wake up, my skin feels good as new. Haven't gotten a zit or breakout, and my skin has just been calmer, smoother, and more hydrated. All the good things! Can't recommend this enough.

I already love the regular solution, but I wanted something that would stay a little longer - and this is EXACTLY it! I use it for my tattoos, and it's perfect for keeping my skin soothed while giving that extra boost of healing it really needs during this stage.
At first I was like hmm this gel feels kinda wierd compared to the spray, but now I love it — way more hydrating and def lasts longer.
The best. I love the solution and love the hydrogel even more

Living in NYC and working out a lot has its drawbacks (acne😭) so I loveeeee packing a spray in my bag if I'm on the go to kill the germs on my face after sweating. I've found that this formula is super moisturizing and perfect for the fall/winter months that make my skin so dry. Totally recommend if you're a girl on the go like me

I have been waiting for this product. I am obsessed with the original spray but wanted something that could cling to my skin/acute areas a bit better and THIS IS IT! It's still a light mist, but is super soothing and cooling. My 6 month old got a cut on his wrist and this was perfect for spot treatment because it clings to the area but also still dries quickly and doesn't leave any greasy residue like a neosporin or similar — important for kids who never stop moving. It healed it up in just a couple days! BUY IT NOW
This product is incredible!! I was already a fan of the solution and I purchased the hydrogel for more targeted use. I am obsessed.
I started spraying this on my face about a week ago before bed and I've already noticed that my forehead acne is clearing up. I don't understand how more people aren't using this, it really works.

I grabbed this so fast when I found it in store because I already love their regular daily spray, and this new gel is INCREDIBLE. I use it daily on my face, hitting zits or blemishes that I need to go away FAST multiple times a day. I love that this version is a gel consistency so it can really absorb into my skin, but still feels super light and fresh. No grease or residue. I also have now successfully used it on some spider bites, on the extra bad sunburn I get around my bathing suit edges where the sunscreen always rubs off (hit it a couple times before bed and woke up with basically no burn), AND on my dog's hotspot from swimming (pro-tip if you haven't tried on your pets yet — do it! It's great and safe for their skin too). I've already reordered!

I was looking for a spray to give me more moisture than the Vichy, Neutrogena, & Evian water sprays I use. Magic molecule Hydro gel spray is exactly what I was looking for to keep the moisture on my skin and give my face a little more plumpness when I'm not wearing make up.
